title: Bundle request handler
software_contract: Return a response describing whether some subset of available offers meets the exact unit target within budget, while preserving preprocessing and response metadata.
input_domain: offers have sku, units, price, available; units/prices are nonnegative integers; target/budget are nonnegative integers; unavailable offers are ignored.
execution_assumptions: The response includes a Boolean result; it does not return a selected subset or its ordering.
Filtering, sorting and response metadata are part of the required behavior.
Offer data arrive classically; encoding and repeated-use assumptions are not settled.
